sections.title: In Brave Frontier I
sections.content: As part of the Battles of Brave Frontier 2 series, Teresa can be fought in The Fighting Nun.

sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A nun who believed she received a revelation from the gods. Although Teresa grew up in the frontier lands where only the strongest survive, she denounced her delinquent ways and pledged herself to the gods after claiming to have heard their voice. As she traveled west to impart on the world the justice the gods had entrusted her with, she ran into a woman wielding a peculiar gun—an antique relic. Believing that such a sacred relic could only be given to those chosen by the gods, she branded the woman as one of the gods' messengers. She then picked up her favorite shotguns from her time in the frontier lands, and began her mission of eliminating those who opposed the gods.

|member = [[Heroes Across Time III]] |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = [[War Declaration Teresa]], Path of Learning Teresa (BFH) |bf2 = true }} '''Teresa''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ===In Brave Frontier I=== As part of the [[Battles of Brave Frontier 2]] series, Teresa can be fought in [[The Fighting Nun]]. ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== A nun who believed she received a revelation from the gods. Although Teresa grew up in the frontier lands where only the strongest survive, she denounced her delinquent ways and pledged herself to the gods after claiming to have heard their voice. As she traveled west to impart on the world the justice the gods had entrusted her with, she ran into a woman wielding a peculiar gun—an antique relic. Believing that such a sacred relic could only be given to those chosen by the gods, she branded the woman as one of the gods' messengers. She then picked up her favorite shotguns from her time in the frontier lands, and began her mission of eliminating those who opposed the gods. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Teresa |element = Earth |image1 = Navi chara bf2 186 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 186 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 186 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 186 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 186 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 186 5.png |image6note = Hurt |image7 = Navi chara bf2 186 6.png |image7note = }} ==Trivia==
